exposure: Medical disorder during the current pregnancy
cohort: 382 pregnant women attending an outpatient clinic at the Maternal and Children Hospital (MCH).
finding: Several factors, including occupational status, antenatal care, pregnancy plan, breastfeeding experience, delivery mode of the last child, medical disorders during pregnancy, age, breastfeeding knowledge, and attitude towards breastfeeding, were found to be potential predictors of EBF intention.
